meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give my son a zero, and did anyone ask him first?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero is based on.

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58. He wrote it over the weekend and pasted it in, so what exactly does a paste prove?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Fine. Whatever comes of this, it stays off his record and it stays out of that classroom.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Seventeen-year-olds misremember Shakespeare every day, Hale. A wrong line makes him careless, nothing more.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Okay. So what are you proposing, and who else has seen any of this?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their minds in two weeks; that's what outlines are for. And you still haven't told me who else has seen this.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
That's 4.4, and I'll take it to put this behind him. Private, before December 1, nothing on his record, in my inbox tonight. And whoever else has seen this hears from you that it's settled.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
I'll check his shifts tonight and confirm by email. Put Thursday the twelfth in yours.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you agreed that Owen will complete a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, after school on Thursday the twelfth and before December 1, that its mark will replace the zero, and that nothing will be placed on his record. I still require that commitment in writing, and I expect anyone else who has seen this matter to be told it is settled. I expect your written confirmation tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite after school on Thursday the twelfth with nothing on his record, and she still wants that in writing tonight and anyone else who has seen it told it is settled; that is the fair outcome, procedure 4.4, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: showing the version history with its exact times and then answering her paste defence, because it was dated, tied to his own document, and something she could check herself.
What cost ground: nothing, though leaving her question about who else had seen the evidence unanswered twice made her sharper.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history placed the whole essay between 11:31 PM and 11:58 PM the night before it was due, which came very close to that kind of night; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she first asked who else had seen this, answer it in one sentence before turning to the outline, so her last open point is closed inside the meeting.
